title: Seeking feedback concerning my analysis model
author: InternationalGene445
selftext:
Hello, I have been working for months at developing an AI assisted macro-economic awareness model. It still has a long way to go, however after reading many authoritative post I think I've managed to avoid the main issues when using AI in this manner. I significantly underestimated the complexity of this experiment and would appreciate some feedback from any quants lurking in these threads. Following is a session extract that is the routine data evaluation after the ingestion phase:



# COMMIT RECEIPT — Update 2026-07-28

`Preload:` ✓ · `Frame:` **none — and that's a slip I'm logging rather than hiding**; a four-chunk Update is exactly the multi-step work r619's frame exists for, and I ran it without one · `Changed:` MSI P1/P2/P3 + integrated read · 18 Signal Tracker rows · 2 Event Log rows · **LR B17 current-value pointer** · appendix STATE-SNAPSHOT · briefing headline · 63 OT stamps · DL198 · LR 734/735 · `Derived recomputed:` freshness\_recalc 40 ages @ 2026-07-28; P1 recomputed from source, recipe reproduced to 3dp first · `Consumers propagated:` snapshot trail · briefing narrative · Event Log · LR current-value row · `Recalc:` 0 errors / 271 formulas · `Readback:` ✓ 10 + 6 asserted cells · `Check:` **CLEAN** \+ 1 declared SKIP (check 10 recon — `crisis_data/` absent by ruling (c)) · `OT-coverage:` **63/63 active threads stamped** · `Logged:` rows 734–735 · `Audit:` two gate findings investigated at source and both real; P1 reproduced against two stored values before use · `Copied: trio to outputs/` — **NOT DONE, declared**: no `outputs/` exists on either tree · `Sentinel:` ✓ · `Mode:` BUILD · **Y1 unchanged v15** `8d4515ed`

# The read

**No scored-leg flip.** net +0.5 / breadth 40% / conviction 7.7% / Tier-1 SPLIT / phase 2 — all held. **P1 −0.304σ (52.4th)**, flat, both drivers easing. **Credit declined to confirm for a third period** — HY 2.79 and BB 1.68 both +2bp, divergence stuck at 1.11 against a 1.44 tripwire.

**The mixed-basis question dissolved on reading the definition.** P1 is defined on *"the latest date carrying BOTH VIX and SP500"* — the pillar pinned its own basis at 07-24. The judgment call I asked you for didn't exist.

**Two things worth your attention.** The Iran arc turned — 13 strike-nights, then a halt, then Omani mediation on *reopening* Hormuz — **while Hormuz throughput got worse** (6 transits against 15) and the escalation moved to Aramco's Jizan and Yanbu. Reading the diplomatic track alone would misprice the physical one. And the loudest number is outside the scored panel entirely: **FINRA margin debt $1.53T, third straight record, +51.5% y/y, investor credit balances at a record low −$1.06T** — on the row you added on 07-22 to catch exactly this, while the panel reads calm.

# Two things the process caught that I didn't

**GDPNow.** I told you it collapsed \~1.4pp. The step-2 cell view showed the row already carried 1.7% from 07-17 — the real move is **−0.1pp, routine**. I'd compared a fresh reading to a stale *external* anchor instead of to the tracker's own prior value. Corrected before it was written.

**DL198.** The gate flagged LR B17 restating curve +0.36 against canonical 0.34. That row is not history — col A reads **"Current value"**, and it's excluded from Y1 *because* it's a live pointer rewritten every Update. The dependency map, whose stated job is to make propagation "a lookup, not a memory act," **doesn't list it**. And it only fired because the curve round-tripped: had the value moved one way, the stale row would have matched nothing and passed silently. Same shape as DL196. Routed as item 10 on the audit thread.

  


**AUTO-LAUNCH INTERPRET is triggered** — events were logged, which is the material threshold. It's owed as the Update's final step and I'll run it as its own chunk rather than bolting it onto this one. Say go.

# S1 · GLANCE

**Phase 2 · Phase-3 watch · no scored flip · Tier-1 split 1 pro / 2 counter.**  
Δ since last render: P1 −0.291 → **−0.304σ** · HY 2.77 → **2.79%** · curve 0.36 → **0.34** · margin debt 1.416 → **1.53T**.  
*Between now and the next scheduled print, the view moves only if a scored rule crosses: jobless claims sustained above 300K, the yield curve back below zero, high-yield spreads through their 1.44 divergence tripwire, or the 30 July claims print resolving the HYP-012 conjunction. Headlines, forecasts, and commentary — including this document's — change nothing by themselves.*  
Next scheduled data: **Thursday 30 July, initial claims.**

  


# S2 · BOARD

>

**TIER 1 — the disagreement**

|signal|sign|value|verified|
|:-|:-|:-|:-|
|Yield curve 10Y-2Y|−|\+0.34 †|07-27 🟢|
|HY spread (OAS)|−|2.79% / 279bp|07-24 🟢|
|VCI (U\_adj)|\+|4.80 †|Jun-2026 🟢|

*The disagreement. Adjusted unemployment adds the people who left the workforce back into the count — it rises while headline unemployment falls. Its + sign is* ***inherited by standing rule, meaning still under test*** *until the Aug-7 grade. The curve's counter-signal is now three periods old.*

**TIER 2 — softer, slower signals showing which side is gaining**

|signal|sign|value|verified|
|:-|:-|:-|:-|
|Conf Board LEI|\+|99.1, −0.2% m/m †|07-20 🟢|
|CEO Confidence|\+|Q2 −12pts|05-28 🟢|
|Initial claims|−|187K|wk 07-18 🟢|
|Michigan sentiment|0|54.4 prelim|07-17 🟢|

*† LEI keeps falling, but its own publisher says* ***no recession signal*** *— the six-month rate is negative and stable, well above the −4.3% trigger. Claims are the tiebreaker and they are not cooperating with the thesis. Sentiment was captured late once before (DL154); this reading is the second consecutive \~10% jump.*

**TIER 3 — what makes this stagflation rather than plain recession — neutral by rule, not by calm**

|signal|sign|value|verified|
|:-|:-|:-|:-|
|CPI YoY|0|3.53%|Jun 🟢|
|Real wages|0|⏳|rule pending data|
|Small-bank CC / BNPL|0.5|elevated|🟡|

**PILLARS** — P1 **−0.304σ** (52nd pctile, 07-24) · P2 divergence **1.11** vs 1.44 tripwire · P3 **0/3**

**Net +0.5 · breadth 40% · dispersion 0.832 · conviction low — the strongest legs cancel (7.7%)**

  


# STORY

>

Three periods running, the machine has said the same thing: equity stress rose a little, and credit declined to ratify it. That is not the panel failing to notice. It is the panel doing exactly what it was built to do — refusing to move the read until the transmission channel confirms.

What changed this period is *not* on the board. The Iran arc turned for the first time — thirteen nights of strikes, then a halt, then Omani mediation on reopening Hormuz — **and the physical measure got worse anyway**: six transits where there had been fifteen. The escalation didn't stop; it moved onshore to Aramco's Jizan and Yanbu. A reader tracking only the diplomatic headline would have marked the risk down. A reader tracking only throughput would have missed the negotiation. Both were happening.

And the loudest number in the entire Update sits outside the scored panel: **margin debt at $1.53 trillion, a third consecutive record, +51.5% year over year, with investor credit balances at a record low of −$1.06 trillion.** That row was added six days ago precisely to catch this. It is not scored, so it does not move the read. It is also the largest single-signal move in the file.

  


# SIGNAL-INTERACTIONS WALKTHROUGH (r520)

**Which signals are interacting.** HY OAS (calm) · the loan-HY basis (−1.27σ, flagged) · BDC discount · margin debt (record) · VIX vs realized volatility · the curve (managed long end).

**The mechanism families** — pointing into the primer rather than re-explaining: **P-3** says the public junk-bond index can sleep through stress because the riskiest borrowers migrated out of it into leveraged loans and private credit; **P-5** says VIX can be sat on by option-selling structure; **P-2** says a healthy curve slope can be issuance strategy rather than optimism. All three describe the same shape: *the visible gauge is calm because the stress moved somewhere the gauge doesn't look.*

**Two competing readings of the configuration, and they are genuinely competing.**

**Reading A — absorption is working.** Oil never held above $100, the pipeline adapted, transits are re-routing, diplomacy has started, credit is calm because there is nothing to transmit. Margin debt is high because the market is rising; leverage follows returns. On this reading, calm is information, and the thesis is losing.

**Reading B — the gauges are looking in the wrong place.** Credit is calm because its composition improved while the risk migrated (P-3); volatility is calm because of structure (P-5); the curve is calm partly by issuance (P-2). Record leverage against record-negative credit balances is not a symptom of health but the fuel that converts an ordinary shock into a forced-selling cascade. On this reading, calm is the absence of a sensor, not the absence of stress.

**The observable that discriminates them.** Not the level of any gauge — the **gap** between a managed gauge and its unmanaged shadow, under stress. Specifically: if the S&P takes a genuine drawdown and the loan-HY basis stays flagged while HY OAS barely moves, and margin debt turns negative month-over-month, that is Reading B with a forced-deleveraging signature. If HY OAS widens *with* the equity move, that is Reading A and the transmission was never broken. **Both are testable at the next real drawdown. Neither is testable today**, which is why nothing here moved the score.

  


# HYPOTHESIS BLOCKS

>

**HYP-012 — labour slow-drift** · DEMOTED-PROVISIONAL. **SURVIVES IF** Thursday's claims come in at or above 207.5k, or a material revision carries 187,000 to ≥207,500. **DIES IF** below 207.5k with no material revision — demotion becomes permanent. Rule fixed 2026-07-28 under r621, two days before the number exists.

**HYP-017 — tail-jump** · SKEW 146.60 (07-27), still elevated. **SURVIVES IF** the configuration persists into a realised tail move. **DIES IF** SKEW normalises without one. Its 07-24 close is still missing from the pull (DL196).

**HYP-016 — dark fleet** · Hormuz transits at 6, Iranian-route substitution continuing. **SURVIVES IF** measured throughput stays suppressed while nominal reopening proceeds. **DIES IF** transit normalises on the sanctioned route.

*WIDEN remains FROZEN. HYP-018..024 are a record of a demonstration run, not live hypotheses.*

  


# CALENDAR

>

**Thu 30 Jul** — initial claims (E25), resolves HYP-012 · **Fri 31 Jul** — Michigan final · **\~Aug 7** — payrolls; HYP-006 print-2 grades the VCI sign, the open question under Tier-1 · **Oct 1** — blind-spot review, VOI sweep, the parked architecture items.

  


**Read-receipt:** no scored leg moved; the two things that moved most — the chokepoint divergence and record leverage — are both unscored by rule, and I have not smuggled either into the read. The honest summary is that **the machine is unchanged and the world is not**, and the discipline is to leave that gap visible rather than close it with a story.
